title: rpl host tests: rpl_srh + rpl_dao_timing fail to build on main (pre-existing)
description: Found during b7z9.183 regression sweep (stash-verified pre-existing, unrelated to that change). Two standalone host tests fail to build: (1) rpl_srh: rpl_dao_tx_persist.h:72 includes lichen/hal_storage_redundant.h but the test CMakeLists lacks the hal include dir (same class as the rpl_dis/rpl_dio_time/rpl_short_assignment breakage fixed in b7z9.183 — add hal include + likely hash32.c/hal_storage_redundant.c). (2) rpl_dao_timing: main.c:449 'invalid storage class for function test_rng' — a real compile error in the test file (likely a missing closing brace above line 449). Neither is exercised by CI host runs apparently, or they'd be red. rpl_routing is a Zephyr find_package test and not host-buildable (not a defect).
